note: Guided tour (presentation only, 11/20). Reuses existing camera shots from design.json; adds no geometry. Each stop says plainly what is decided by the owner and what is still open.

stops.title: Front door, first floor
stops.text: This is the owner's design as of the 11/20 owner sheets. Walls are traced from the drawings and are accurate to about 4 in; nothing is field-measured yet. Finishes shown are a working concept, not selections.

stops.title: Living room
stops.text: The feature wall holds the TV and fireplace only; no duct chase runs in it (owner, 11/20).

stops.title: Kitchen and the duct riser
stops.text: The house ducts rise in a chase beside the stair on the kitchen side, with the fridge against it (owner, 11/20). The chase size is a placeholder until the mechanical engineer sizes the ducts.

stops.title: Master bath double vanity
stops.text: A 60 in double vanity, with the wall to the bedroom moved about 16 in (owner, 11/19). Before framing: measure the bath and bedroom, and the engineer confirms the wall is not bearing.

stops.title: Lower level common hall
stops.text: The new 1-hour wall (shown in red) and its 45-minute self-closing door separate the family room, where you are standing, from the common hall beyond. DOB raised no objection on these conditions (11/05); the plan reviewer makes the decision.

cam.name: Common hall door from the family room

stops.title: Apartment living area
stops.text: The apartment layout (Option A) is the owner's concept and is not yet on the architect's set. Heating and cooling is a ductless wall unit; the unit size is not selected.

stops.title: Apartment bedroom
stops.text: A second wall unit sits on the east (outside) wall (owner, 11/18), so its line set goes straight out and nothing crosses a rated wall. Exact spot per the HVAC designer.

stops.title: Family room brick wall
stops.text: The old brick wall stays exposed on both faces (owner, 11/18). It is also the separation from the apartment, so the architect must confirm its fire rating without furring.
